autoSwap.label: Auto swap
autoSwap.summary: Low-value trade ($0.30 USD) auto-executed atomically on Sepolia in a single transaction without human delay (< $1.00 threshold).

approvalRequested.label: Approval requested
approvalRequested.summary: High-value trade ($3.00 USD) intercepted and held onchain on Sepolia awaiting World ID Agent Pass human approval.

worldApproved.label: Human approved
worldApproved.summary: World ID human proof validated server-side; relayer attestation signed with single-use request nullifier.

swapExecuted.label: Swap executed
swapExecuted.summary: Atomic execution unlocked on Sepolia through AegisExecutionManager.approveWithRelayer into Uniswap V3.

blockedDenied.label: Denied: blocked
blockedDenied.summary: Operator explicitly rejected the trade; request cancelled onchain via cancelRequest, leaving trade unexecuted.

blockedExpired.label: Expired: rejected
blockedExpired.summary: 15-minute deadline lapsed without attestation; approval rejected onchain and trade remained unexecuted.
